partner_context.their_ambition: Red Sea Global is building the world's most ambitious regenerative tourism destinations — The Red Sea and AMAALA — an archipelago of ultra-luxury resorts on a protected reef system, with a 100% renewable-energy, low-carbon promise at the core of the brand.
partner_context.their_pressure: Guest mobility across dozens of islands must match that promise: silent, clean, gentle on the reef, and flawlessly premium. Diesel transfers undercut the entire proposition.
partner_context.where_navier_fits: Navier is the on-water signature experience — software-defined foiling that glides silently between islands with zero emissions over the reef, and Quanta-LR range to connect the destination to NEOM and Jeddah.

hero.title: Red Sea Global × Navier — silent, zero-emission island-hopping for a regenerative destination
hero.subtitle: An archipelago of luxury resorts needs guest mobility that matches the brand: fast, smooth, silent and clean. Foiling is the answer.
hero.what_we_do_together: We give The Red Sea and AMAALA a software-defined foiling fleet for guest island-hopping. Pioneer II glides silently between the hub and the resort islands with zero emissions over protected reef; Quanta-LR's hybrid range connects the destination to NEOM and the Jeddah gateway as single smooth legs. It is the on-water signature experience for a destination built around sustainability.

why_now: Red Sea Global is built on a regenerative, low-carbon promise across a sensitive marine environment — exactly where silent, zero-emission foiling belongs. Foiling lifts the hull clear of the water: smooth in chop, near-silent on approach, dramatically efficient, and gentle on reef. Pioneer II needs no charging infrastructure beyond a berth pedestal; Quanta-LR adds long-range hybrid reach with no infrastructure dependency. A ~100-vessel Navier network is already ramping in the Maldives (Bloomberg/WSJ, 2026) — the resort-archipelago playbook, ready to replicate.

differentiation.vs_ferry: Conventional transfer boats are noisy, diesel and reef-disturbing. Foiling is silent on approach, zero-emission over the reef, and smooth in chop — the only mobility that matches a regenerative brand.
differentiation.vs_candela: Candela's 8 × P-12 order for neighbouring NEOM proves PIF and Saudi destinations already trust foiling — that validates the category at your doorstep. Navier is complementary, not competing: where the P-12 is a 30-pax fixed-route public shuttle, Navier delivers the bespoke, on-demand luxury guest-transfer tier and the Quanta-LR hybrid range (2,000 nm) to connect The Red Sea to AMAALA, NEOM and Jeddah with no charging infrastructure.
differentiation.navier_moat: Software-defined and autonomy-ready, a marquee cap table, a Turkey factory for supply, and — decisively — a ~100-vessel luxury-archipelago network already ramping in the Maldives: the exact playbook, ready to replicate.

proof_points.evidence: Candela's largest-ever order — 8 × P-12 — is for neighbouring NEOM.

proof_points.claim: The luxury-archipelago playbook is proven at scale.
proof_points.evidence: ~100 vessels / ~$100M / 3-year phasing in the Maldives — 'the playbook to replicate'.

objections.concern: Is foiling gentle on the protected reef?
objections.response: Yes — the hull flies clear of the surface, so there is minimal wake, no diesel discharge, near-silent approach and zero emissions over sensitive water: the most reef-respectful powered mobility available.

Different layers. The P-12 is a fixed-route public shuttle; Navier is the bespoke on-demand luxury guest-transfer tier plus the long-range hybrid that connects your destinations. A regenerative archipelago needs the silent premium layer — and the Maldives proves Navier delivers it.
Pioneer II covers intra-destination island hops; Quanta-LR (2,000 nm hybrid) connects The Red Sea↔AMAALA↔NEOM↔Jeddah with no charging-infrastructure dependency.

the_ask.navier_brings: The software-defined foiling fleet (Pioneer II + Quanta-LR), the Maldives-proven luxury-archipelago playbook, captain training, certification and operations.
the_ask.partner_brings: The destinations, the guest demand, the berths and the regenerative brand mandate.
the_ask.next_step: A resort-island shuttle pilot delivering the signature silent arrival experience.

close.title: Silent, clean island-hopping — worthy of the destination.
close.body: From a resort-island shuttle to a destination-wide network to the Saudi Red Sea luxury chain, Navier gives Red Sea Global the on-water signature experience its regenerative promise calls for — and the Maldives playbook proves it works.
